sources.title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
sources.snippet: This report introduces a new family of AI models purposefully designed for robotics and built upon the foundation of Gemini 2.0. We present Gemini Robotics, an advanced Vision-Language-Action (VLA) generalist model capable of directly controlling robots.
